note: Identity-color rulings that beat the hex-hue rule: a school counts under the one color a fan would name, or null for none. Auburn is an orange school whatever its navy primary hex says; the old-gold schools (Purdue, Wake, Mizzou) read orange by hue but are gold; West Virginia and UConn list gold or black hexes first but are blue schools; Coastal's teal goes to green; Charlotte and Troy have no hex in CFBD at all.
